body.statement:
Let \(m\geq3\), \(s\geq0\), and let \(p'\in[1,\infty)\), \(C_0<\infty\), and \(c_0>0\) be fixed.  For \(n\) independent observations from a density on \(\mathcal Y=[0,1]^m\) belonging to the radius-\(C_0\) Besov class of smoothness \(s\), integrability index \(p'\), and summability index infinity, and bounded below by \(c_0\), the wavelet estimator of Niles--Weed and Berthet satisfies
\[
 \sup_f E_f\!\left[W_1(\widehat Q_f,Q_f)\right]
 \leq C n^{-(s+1)/(2s+m)}.
\]
Here \(C\) depends only on the displayed fixed class parameters.

source.locator: Section 2.2.1, Theorem 1, bounded-density case, specialized to Wasserstein order one and outcome dimension at least three
source.verbatim_statement: \(\sup_{f\in\mathcal B^s_{p',q}(L;m)}\mathbb E W_p(f,\widehat f)\lesssim n^{-(1+s)/(d+2s)},\quad d\geq3.\)
